tasks.title: Create opencode-model-discovery service with TTL cache
tasks.description: Implement OpencodeDiscoveryService in src/services/opencode-discovery-service.ts. It spawns a short-lived opencode acp process, calls initialize → newSession({ cwd }), extracts availableModels from the response, caches with 5-minute TTL, and provides getAvailableModels() and refresh() methods. Uses resolveOpencodeBinPath for bin path. Handles probe errors gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Service exposes getAvailableModels() returning string[]
Service exposes refresh() to force-clear cache
First call spawns ACP probe; second call within TTL returns cached result
Probe failure returns error without crashing
Typecheck passes

tasks.description: Create src/api/opencode-models.ts with Hono router exposing GET /api/opencode/models. Returns { models: string[] } from OpencodeDiscoveryService. Returns 503 if discovery fails. Wire it into server/index.ts under /api/opencode.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/opencode/models returns 200 with { models: [...] }
Cache hit returns immediately without spawning new probe
Probe failure returns 503 with error details
Route mounted at /api/opencode in server/index.ts
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Add stage field to AcpSessionOptions and implement model override in runAcpSession
tasks.description: Add stage?: string to AcpSessionOptions. After newSession and before prompt in runAcpSession: resolve effective model (stageModels[stage] > opencode.model > null), validate against discovery service, call setSessionConfigOption({ configId: 'model', value: '...' }) if set, wrap in try/catch and log model_fallback on failure. Write model_selected event to workflow_log on success.
acceptanceCriteria: AcpSessionOptions has optional stage: string field
newSession → setSessionConfigOption called before prompt when model is resolved
model_selected event written to workflow_log with { model, stage, source }
setSessionConfigOption failure with non-default model triggers model_fallback event and continues
Configured model not in availableModels list causes spawn to fail fast with error listing available models
Typecheck passes
